bio.text: Yolanda Prince won the May 26, 2026 Democratic primary runoff for Texas's 1st Congressional District over Dax Alexander and faces Republican Rep. Nathaniel Moran in the November general election.
KETK reported that she has worked in education, nonprofit organizations and government.
She graduated from Stephen F. Austin State University with degrees in public administration and communications and holds a master's in public administration from the University of Texas at Arlington.
She has served as a precinct chair, election judge and president of the Democratic Club of Smith County for about a decade, and was a delegate to the 2012 Democratic National Convention.
